articles.title: Startup sues Apple in India over tap-to-share contacts feature
articles.summary: A US startup has filed a lawsuit against Apple in India, seeking $162 million in damages and an injunction that could potentially affect the import of iPhones and Apple Watches into the country due to a tap-to-share feature.

articles.title: Spotify founder Daniel Ek backs fusion power startup Europa Fusion
articles.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, a new fusion power startup founded by an artificial intelligence researcher. The company aims to develop advanced energy solutions leveraging modern computational and physics approaches.

articles.title: AI and human researchers claim solutions to the Riemann hypothesis
articles.summary: Mathematicians are astonished after an artificial intelligence system generated a purported solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis. Interestingly, a human researcher has also put forward a competing solution to the famous mathematical problem.

articles.title: Bending Spoons acquires marketing platform Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
articles.summary: Bending Spoons has purchased Mailchimp for $3.68 billion. Since Intuit originally acquired the same company in 2021 for approximately $12 billion, the recent transaction represents a significant discount for the new buyers.

articles.title: Transcription firm exposes sensitive police and court data online
articles.summary: A security lapse at a transcription firm used by police prosecutors and tech companies left sensitive files exposed. Confidential records including police interviews and bodycam footage were found on an unpassworded cloud server.

articles.title: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over former CEO's China ties
articles.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has issued a subpoena to Nvidia. Officials are investigating whether the company and its former chief executive misled investors regarding business connections and activities involving China.

articles.title: YouTube reportedly plans to settle addiction claims for $3 billion
articles.summary: YouTube is reportedly nearing a $3 billion agreement in principle to settle claims with thousands of school districts. The lawsuits allege that the platform's addictive design harmed children, and the deal would introduce new teen safeguards.

articles.title: Rockstar Games reports GTA VI earned $3.79 billion on launch day
articles.summary: Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in sales during its first day on the market. The massive launch also included 32.5 million preorder copies sold, setting a new entertainment industry record.

articles.title: Trump threatens heavy tariffs on data centers built outside the US
articles.summary: President Donald Trump stated that companies building artificial intelligence data centers outside of the United States will face severe financial penalties. He emphasized a commitment to keeping technology infrastructure domestic.

articles.title: Google to shut down Nest app and Google Assistant on speakers
articles.summary: Google is overhauling its smart home ecosystem by retiring Google Assistant on smart speakers next year. The company will also shut down the legacy Nest app in early 2027, migrating all management features to the Google Home app.

articles.title: Anthropic mathematician uses Claude to tackle Riemann hypothesis
articles.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have successfully proved the Riemann hypothesis using the Claude AI model. If verified by the mathematical community, this breakthrough would mark a major milestone for artificial intelligence in mathematics.

articles.title: FCC blocks California from enforcing specific phone service rules
articles.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has intervened against state regulations, declaring that California is not permitted to enforce rules requiring telecommunications companies like AT&T to continuously maintain home phone services.

articles.title: Google redesigns search homepage to feature AI chat history
articles.summary: Google has updated its main search homepage to provide easier access to artificial intelligence tools. The redesigned interface prominently features AI chat history while removing the traditional search button for a more conversational experience.

articles.title: Meta reconsiders net-zero 2030 target amid rising AI emissions
articles.summary: Meta is actively re-evaluating its corporate sustainability goals for 2030. The shift comes as power demands from expanding artificial intelligence data centers drive the company's greenhouse gas emissions to record levels.

articles.title: Astronomers observe giant star swallowing a neighboring star
articles.summary: A recent celestial brightening event has been explained by astronomers as a stellar collision. Researchers observed a scenario where a giant star engulfed an orbiting companion star before the combined system ultimately exploded.

articles.title: Prisons permitted to jam contraband phones despite interference worries
articles.summary: Correctional facilities have received authorization to jam contraband mobile phones. However, industry groups warn that testing demonstrates this signal-blocking technology can inadvertently disrupt communications for nearby consumer phones up to miles away.

articles.title: Army delays detonating hazardous lead azide over safety concerns
articles.summary: The US Army has postponed plans to detonate a hazardous supply of lead azide. Computer modeling indicated that the resulting explosion could release a toxic plume of neurotoxic lead particles traveling up to 100 miles away.

articles.title: SpaceX lenders express concern over sending chip collateral into orbit
articles.summary: Financial bondholders backing SpaceX are raising concerns regarding their collateral. Lenders want valuable computer hardware and chip assets kept safely on Earth rather than being launched into orbit on spacecraft.

articles.title: YouTube faces $3 billion settlement over alleged teen addiction
articles.summary: YouTube is reportedly negotiating a massive financial settlement with school districts. The legal claims center on allegations that the video platform utilizes deliberately addictive designs that negatively impact the mental health of teenagers.
